lines.text: Only one coach in Barsa history hit a hundred wins faster than Hansi Flick.
Lewees Enreekay took a hundred and twenty-six games. Flick, a hundred and thirty-one.
But no Barsa coach has ever won more often: seventy-six percent.
Win one hundred came straight after defeats to P-S-G and Ray-al Madrid.
Barsa answered with a six-one win over Ahlah-vess.
The opener took fifteen passes and nine players.
Four goals by half-time. Two more after the break.
Raffeenya scored twice: fifteen league goals in eleven games, matching Sezar Rodreegez and Messi.
Lameen Yamal scored twice too. Fairmeen Lopez: a goal and two assists.
Where does Flick rank among Barsa's coaches? Tell us below.
